commit.message:
Add infrastructure for speculative remote V2 compaction (#53614)

## What changed

- Capture history, prompt metadata, routing state, authentication ownership, and context-window identity for background compaction requests.
- Send background requests over HTTP while preserving foreground routing, and retain the latest candidate in session memory.
- Add feature and threshold eligibility checks and deduplicate attempts by history version, model, compaction hash, and authentication ownership.
- Cancel and drain background tasks during session shutdown, preserving completed usage accounting.

The background launch helper is not yet connected to the turn loop.

GitOrigin-RevId: 0e5e6ab7dac4d98a836733668a775ac48b5a59f1

Prepare compaction helpers for background requests (#53606)

## What changed

- Extract an HTTP Responses executor that can run without owning a turn's WebSocket state, with optional authentication-owner checks.
- Add cancellation-aware compaction output collection that records background token usage against the rollout budget.
- Support installing a compacted history prefix while preserving later history items and placing initial context around real user or agent messages.
- Allow callers to supply a context window for history trimming and a captured window for compaction request metadata.

GitOrigin-RevId: 29f3ca0ae8841f295058feb207e3a225af9a1487

Add async compaction feature configuration (#53595)

## What changed

Register the disabled-by-default `async_compaction` feature and accept either a boolean or a `[features.async_compaction]` table. Add `model_async_compact_threshold_percent` with a default of 65 and a valid range of 1–100, validated even when the feature is disabled. Setting a threshold alone does not enable the feature.

Expose the threshold in the runtime configuration and update the JSON schema for both configuration forms.

## Testing

Add configuration loader tests covering boolean and table forms, default and custom thresholds, explicit enablement, and rejection of out-of-range values.

GitOrigin-RevId: cf33de76878e7044bc8cf5d146375a07ea9eb078

Deduplicate TUI modifier handling and terminal color caching (#53556)

## What changed

- Reuse `custom_terminal::ModifierDiff` when writing history spans.
- Share the terminal default-color probe and cache implementation between Unix and Windows.

Both changes remove duplicate implementations while preserving existing behavior.

GitOrigin-RevId: 35f8d77ade972b791c6beac0678d2fe2be3aa763

Reject duplicate Host headers in the network proxy (#53506)

## Why

Policy evaluation and upstream parsers must not select different `Host` field lines from the same request.

## What changed

Return `400 Bad Request` for multiple `Host` headers, including identical values, before policy evaluation, upstream forwarding, or Unix socket routing. Apply the check to both plain HTTP requests and `CONNECT` requests.

## Testing

Add regression tests covering identical and conflicting headers in origin-form, absolute-form, and `CONNECT` requests, verifying rejection without an upstream connection. Also cover single-header forwarding and rejection before Unix socket routing.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8ec95171e120f784629d3121b9a1bedbaf88e7cd

Preserve pending Effects toggles across save refreshes (#53496)

## Why

Saving an Effects preference refreshes the picker. When users toggle repeatedly before saves finish, that refresh can discard newer choices and cause subsequent toggles to use stale values.

## What changed

- Update Effects checkboxes immediately and track pending saves per row, preserving newer choices when an earlier save takes effect.
- Preserve pending Composer stars choices while Animations disables the row, and clear pending state on a regular panel refresh.
- Use the shared list toggle handling for Effects, including Space support, while giving configured key bindings precedence over Space toggling.

## Testing

Add regression tests for repeated toggles across save refreshes, pending Composer stars choices while disabled, clearing pending state, and a Space cancel binding taking precedence over toggling. Update the Effects picker snapshot.

GitOrigin-RevId: 847dcc2dfd40448c7adc56c8c40879db28b1fc39

Update `quinn-proto` to 0.11.18 (#53485)

## What changed

Update `codex-rs/Cargo.lock` and `MODULE.bazel.lock` for `quinn-proto` 0.11.18, replacing 0.11.15. Refresh its resolved dependencies to use `rand` 0.10.1 and `getrandom` 0.4.2, and add `rand_pcg` 0.10.2.

GitOrigin-RevId: 642bdeccbff8017f2f97b640a2b2c48294c97bba

Prefer the Windows clipboard and bound copy attempts on WSL (#53453)

## Why

WSLg clipboard initialization can block indefinitely, and PowerShell clipboard writes can stall while receiving input or exiting. These stalls can prevent subsequent TUI copy requests from completing.

## What changed

- Try the Windows clipboard first for `/copy` and `Ctrl+O` on WSL, falling back to the native clipboard and terminal delivery when needed.
- Give Windows executable discovery and writing a shared five-second deadline, with a separate one-second deadline for native clipboard setup. Reuse pending setup tasks after timeouts to avoid accumulating blocked threads.
- Launch PowerShell through a native shell and stop its process group on write failures or timeouts. Reap the writer before returning so an older copy cannot overwrite a newer one, and suppress stderr that could expose clipboard contents.

## Testing

Add tests for command compatibility, large Unicode input, expired requests, and cleanup of stalled writers and subprocesses. Update routing tests to cover Windows-first copying and native fallback with HTML and clipboard leases.

GitOrigin-RevId: 218c8541a169a16536db0370455e076a31a42b1f

Close input admission while a turn finishes recording (#53452)

## Why

Inputs arriving during turn finalization could be queued after the final batch had already been drained, or recorded ahead of that batch.

## What changed

Mark active turns as finishing before draining pending input. Reject injection into finishing turns and make late client responses and notifications wait until the final batch is recorded before appending to history. Continue accepting input into turns reserved but not yet started.

## Testing

Extend the task-completion test to block final recording, verify that input admission is closed, and confirm that a late notification is recorded after queued input while preserving the notification truncation budget. Strengthen the retained-tool-output scenario to assert tool output names and ordering.

GitOrigin-RevId: a57e44bd974e60e134183dab989795e2c3538596

Treat incomplete responses as terminal errors (#53451)

## Why

Incomplete responses such as `max_output_tokens` were classified as stream errors, allowing retries and compaction model fallback after the response had hit its output limit.

## What changed

Introduce `ResponseIncomplete` errors that preserve the server-provided reason and stop stream processing immediately. Make these errors non-retryable and stop compaction without falling back to the selected model. Record incomplete responses separately in sampler failure metrics.

## Testing

Add regression tests that verify incomplete responses surface a terminal error without retries over SSE and WebSocket, and that compaction stops without retrying or switching models for both local and remote compaction.

GitOrigin-RevId: 6e107d441b9bf03fa47ea47b88eeb94b71a9f729

Suppress repeated turn diffs in `codex exec` human output (#53444)

## Why

Repeated turn diff notifications can print the same file changes multiple times, including after an unrelated command.

## What changed

Track the last diff and print nonempty updates only when they differ from the previous notification. Remember empty updates so a restored diff prints again, and reset the tracked diff when a new turn starts.

## Testing

Add a stderr snapshot test covering repeated, changed, empty, restored, and new-turn diffs. Add an integration test that applies one edit, runs an unrelated command, and verifies that the diff appears exactly once.

GitOrigin-RevId: db0a2aa8b77b800ca661e7d1314ed1e571743e74

Use local MSVC toolchains for native Windows Bazel tests (#53443)

## Why

Hermetic LLVM targets the GNU ABI on Windows even when an MSVC platform is selected. Native MSVC builds need the runner's MSVC toolchains and SDK environment.

## What changed

- Register the local x64 and ARM64 C++ toolchains in `ci-windows-msvc`.
- Apply `--config=ci-windows-msvc` to the native Windows Bazel test job.
- Allow the native Windows test job to run on `workflow_dispatch` as well as pushes to `main` so toolchain changes can be tested manually.

GitOrigin-RevId: b9fbd3f2bba8a3a8bf226cafda19a921c8738acd

Preserve status line accents on 16-color terminals (#53440)

## Why

RGB and extended indexed theme colors cannot be displayed directly on 16-color terminals, causing status line items to lose their color accents.

## What changed

Use each status line item's existing ANSI fallback accent when its theme foreground requires RGB or an indexed color beyond the first 16 colors.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for uncolored output with `FORCE_COLOR=0` and ANSI status line accents with `FORCE_COLOR=1`. Give the RGB styling test explicit terminal colors so it consistently exercises true-color behavior.

GitOrigin-RevId: 213ca5c6c366f0a3c696aab256a0b146558a2837

Stop identifying Apple Terminal from `TERM_SESSION_ID` (#53438)

## Why

`TERM_SESSION_ID` is not specific to Apple Terminal. Treating it as an Apple Terminal identifier can mask Windows Terminal detection and the `TERM` fallback.

## What changed

Remove the `TERM_SESSION_ID` detection heuristic. Apple Terminal remains detectable through `TERM_PROGRAM=Apple_Terminal`.

## Testing

Update tests to cover Windows Terminal detection and the `TERM` fallback when `TERM_SESSION_ID` is present, and Apple Terminal detection with its version and user-agent token.

GitOrigin-RevId: 27db11cb7bcca8f94888f9e21a6cdfcf31561b1b

Route TUI request replies to their originating connection and thread (#53436)

## Why

Pending requests can outlive a session switch, and different threads or connections can reuse request IDs. Replies and resolution notifications must stay associated with the request that prompted them.

## What changed

- Retain the original app-server reply handle for pending and buffered requests, including requests replayed after thread attachment or session reset.
- Scope user input, MCP elicitation, and user verification bookkeeping by thread, and send user input answers to the requesting thread.
- Keep background resolution notifications from dismissing foreground prompts.
- Consume failed replies to closed connections and clear pending replay state without falling through to another request route.

## Testing

Add WebSocket regression tests for direct and buffered approvals with colliding request IDs and replies to closed connections. Extend coverage for foreground prompt preservation and thread-scoped user verification cancellation.

GitOrigin-RevId: 541acb9910e92f6f2e83c27d2a2384185d4f8fec

Apply configuration toggles live and improve settings navigation (#53429)

## Why

Several configuration toggles required restarting Codex, and settings search only filtered the current group. Narrow terminals also truncated setting values and descriptions.

## What changed

- Apply animations, composer stars, paste detection, automatic recaps, and tips without restarting Codex. Update active motion effects and paste detection when their preferences change.
- Group animations and composer stars in an Effects picker that refreshes after saving and requires animations for composer stars.
- Search across all configuration groups, show each result's group, and preserve the query when switching groups.
- Keep setting values visible in narrow terminals and show the selected description below the list. Reserve space to keep the panel height stable and tailor footer hints to the selected action.
- Simplify configuration notices and omit routine save confirmations.

## Testing

Add and update tests and snapshots for live preference saves while offline, paste detection updates, Effects picker refreshes, global search, and stable panel height at narrow widths.

GitOrigin-RevId: 83773da2f6457ce461ef16f0cddde0df640a36c3

Preserve Windows runtime registration failure diagnostics (#53426)

## Why

Managed runtime package registration errors lacked the terminal status, separate async and deployment error codes, and deployment activity ID needed to diagnose failures.

## What changed

Include these diagnostics in registration errors and distinguish failures in `GetResults`, the `ExtendedErrorCode` getter, and deployment itself. Preserve the original completion error; failures to read diagnostic fields do not turn successful registration into failure. Keep free-form Windows error text out of diagnostic summaries.

## Testing

Add unit tests for distinct async and deployment errors, failed or canceled result retrieval, and diagnostic getter failures, including preservation of native error codes and omission of free-form diagnostic text.

GitOrigin-RevId: 7f3a46741304ef04f5c3e2aa575bcfc4392dff62

Add regression coverage for network grants on cold thread resume (#53424)

## What changed

Add a Linux app-server integration test that resumes a saved read-only thread after the default permissions change to `:danger-full-access`. Verify that the live network proxy honors restored grants, requests approval for a new host, persists the approved rule, and reuses it without another approval.

The test also verifies that proxied requests succeed while direct access remains blocked.

GitOrigin-RevId: 08f63efb8752d738df0ee97e4e98c3366ae54f56

Restore saved thread permissions during configuration loading (#53419)

## Why

Restoring unnamed thread permissions after configuration loading leaves network proxy initialization and permission validation using the configured default. A saved read-only thread should also resume when that default is incompatible with current managed requirements.

## What changed

Apply eligible saved permission profiles during configuration loading, before network preparation and final validation. Keep explicit permission overrides and managed requirements authoritative, preserve managed deny-read restrictions, and reject saved external enforcement or materialized filesystem grants. Include the saved profile in the app-server's prepared resume configuration state.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for resuming saved read-only permissions with an incompatible full-access default and for retaining managed, remembered, and newly approved network domains in the restored profile's proxy allowlist.

GitOrigin-RevId: 73e32b0a31ac678fd3f60a8ccf8fa9df627f16c3

Isolate arg0 helper directories by operating system (#53412)

## Why

Windows and WSL can share `CODEX_HOME` without sharing a lock namespace, allowing cleanup to remove another platform's live helpers. Older clients can also clean helpers stored under the shared `tmp/arg0` root.

## What changed

Create helpers under `CODEX_HOME/tmp/arg0-<os>` and limit stale-directory cleanup to that operating system's root. Keep permission discovery compatible with both the current platform's root and legacy `tmp/arg0` directories, while ignoring other platforms' aliases.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for cleanup isolation, live helper preservation during legacy cleanup, and selection of the first session alias directory from either supported root.

GitOrigin-RevId: f34292748b5b1d3c25629604d849db4b133dfa3a

Add explicit local board connections with fixed runtime access (#53400)

## Why

Local message boards were scoped to an agent tree. Independently created Codex runtimes need a way to share a board while receiving different access permissions.

## What changed

- Add `LocalBoard` and `LocalBoardConnection` so hosts can supply read-only or read-write access through `thread_extension_init`, including for isolated, ephemeral runtimes.
- Allow read-only connections to read and manage their own subscriptions; reject posting, replying, channel creation, and changes to another agent's subscriptions. Expose effective permissions in channel discovery.
- Use unique runtime paths and require matching board IDs and canonical database paths when resolving agents or delivering notifications.
- Document explicit extension installation and connection setup for new runtimes, cold resumes, and forks.

## Testing

Add a scenario and context snapshot covering an independent writer and isolated Guardian sharing a board through a symlink alias, read-only permission denials, subscription and explicit notifications, and rejection of notifications to an unconnected runtime before a post is written.

GitOrigin-RevId: f92410c3a5c6a46920c3e0e71849c85dc83d9c31

Distinguish Guardian parent-compaction failure reasons (#53393)

## Why

The generic `parent_compaction_error` classification metric does not distinguish serialization failures, oversized compactions, and unusable compactions.

## What changed

Record separate `failure_reason` values for each case: `parent_compaction_serialization`, `parent_compaction_oversized`, and `parent_compaction_unusable`.

## Testing

Extend parent-compaction reuse tests to cover unusable checkpoints in parent-context mode and assert specific failure reasons. Verify rejected compactions receive the maximum risk score, provide no cached approval, and do not reuse stale context.

GitOrigin-RevId: 103c4173b2ebbdc33eb71bce7f8ecb56f73055f6

Use cached login credentials for Guardian decisions (#53389)

## Why

Reading `OPENAI_API_KEY` directly bypasses login credentials reloaded by `AuthManager`.

## What changed

Use the API key from `AuthManager`'s cached authentication for Guardian decisions when the provider is `openai` and has no custom base URL. Keep `CODEX_GUARDIAN_DECISIONS_API_KEY` as the highest-priority override.

## Testing

Add a regression test covering a reloaded API-key login, override precedence, and rejection of the login-key fallback for a custom base URL. Assertions avoid printing credentials on failure.

GitOrigin-RevId: 10b2e6c28d3268c3808c25b2be94d9b6c31f597a

Ignore the unsafe-libyaml advisory in dependency audits (#53382)

## Why

`unsafe-libyaml` is unmaintained and has no patched release. It remains a transitive dependency through `serde_yaml`.

## What changed

Add `RUSTSEC-2024-0449` to the ignore lists in `codex-rs/.cargo/audit.toml` and `codex-rs/deny.toml`. Document the dependency path and require removing the exception when the affected users migrate off `serde_yaml`/`unsafe-libyaml`.

GitOrigin-RevId: 6f4cf32e55d2877d90bf00d2c12a1c85f18d229e

Allow turns when the agent message board is unavailable (#53369)

## Why

With `multi_agent_v2.disable_direct_message` enabled, an unavailable agent message board could cause tool router construction to reject the turn.

## What changed

Remove the requirement that the router expose the board's `post` tool. Unavailable board calls return an unsupported-call error to the model, allowing the turn to continue.

## Testing

Update scenario coverage for a disabled board feature, legacy agents, and ephemeral sessions. Assert that unavailable board calls return an error to the model, that `post`, `send_message`, and `followup_task` are not advertised, and that no board database is created.

GitOrigin-RevId: cb9571459c128d84c3c96f185e70c404e0463473

Remove selected protocol, apply-patch, MCP, and TUI tests (#53358)

## What changed

Remove eight tests covering experimental API schema filtering and marking,
end-of-file unified diffs, MCP prompt auto-approval, and local-link regex
initialization. Remove the associated unused test imports and regex coverage
comment. Runtime behavior is unchanged.

GitOrigin-RevId: 91f59cab82393d43000eadf4e7c55e3a6ec2aa14

Test final polling of remote processes with open output streams (#53339)

## What changed

Add a unified execution test where `exec_command` yields a session and a subsequent `write_stdin` poll completes after the remote process exits while its output stream remains open. Verify that the poll returns the delayed output and exit code, emits the command completion event, and removes the background session without issuing a `process/read` request.

GitOrigin-RevId: 3a316eb9f6b29682da81a2ecbdda52f659f4b792

Finish remote exec cleanup when output streams remain open (#53331)

## Why

A remote process can exit while its output stream remains open, leaving the exit watcher waiting and delaying `ExecCommandEnd` even after output collection finishes.

## What changed

Cancel the process output token after final collection or polling, on one-shot cancellation, and after confirmed termination. This releases the exit watcher while allowing delayed output to be collected before the final poll completes.

## Testing

Add remote process event tests for output streams that remain open at the collection deadline, during interruption, and during explicit termination. Assert that `ExecCommandEnd` preserves the exit code and aggregated output, background terminals are cleared, and interruption and termination require no extra `process/read` requests.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8346e5ce446280915b6e2ffa362fcfd79280bfff

Support Windows clipboard text paste shortcuts in the TUI (#53224)

## Why

`Ctrl+V` previously attempted only image paste, so a text-only clipboard produced an image-paste error. `Shift+Insert` did not use the clipboard paste path.

## What changed

- On Windows, let `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste images first, then read clipboard text asynchronously when no image is available. Keep clipboard access errors distinct from missing images.
- Allow keyboard paste into composer selections and active history or Vim search queries, including inline mode with right-click paste disabled.
- Flush buffered typing before explicit paste to preserve input order. Discard pending clipboard text when the thread or editable target changes, while allowing shortcut releases and repeated paste shortcuts to leave the read pending.

## Testing

Extend shortcut and clipboard-worker tests to cover text fallback, multiline Unicode text, stale-read cancellation, shortcut releases and repeats, and read-only drafts. Add assertions for history-search preview stability and selection changes.

GitOrigin-RevId: 080c1c05a4587e325cea938a6e28c646b9ac5837

Keep agents navigation available after a thread is archived (#53201)

## Why

After a thread was archived externally, the TUI still advertised the Left-arrow agents shortcut, but pressing it in an empty composer did not open the agents view.

## What changed

Reuse the agents navigation handler when connected to an unavailable thread. Preserve the existing empty-composer and editor guards, and require a key press so repeated Left-arrow events do not open the view.

## Testing

Add a regression test for external thread archiving that verifies draft editing, the shortcut hint, ignored key repeats, and opening the agents command center, with a snapshot of the resulting view.

GitOrigin-RevId: a3f36b42bafee948ed7f5842fcb425e414d7e024

Allow restarting managed background servers from the TUI (#53173)

## Why

Startup configuration warnings can reflect settings from when the background server started, even after those settings have been fixed. A restart lets users refresh the server without leaving the TUI.

## What changed

- Add a confirmed restart action to `/daemon`, warning that active or queued work in other chats may be interrupted. Reconnect automatically and let an in-progress restart finish if the TUI exits.
- Verify that Codex manages a local server before enabling restart, including servers discovered with auto-start disabled and those started by `codex agents`.
- Show a restart hint on the first startup configuration warning for managed servers, preserving the original diagnostic for copying and dismissal.
- Repaint the full surface of centered dialogs to restore background colors over cached blank cells.

## Testing

Add CLI integration coverage for agents startup and restarting a discovered daemon with auto-start disabled. Extend TUI tests for confirmation, cancellation, unmanaged servers, warning hints and dismissal, and dialog background rendering.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8e4319fab84f13bf6e7335deb93364fccaff14a7

Simplify the custom terminal drawing API (#53156)

## What changed

Remove `Terminal::autoresize` and the fallible `try_draw` helpers. Render directly in `draw_with_size`, retaining automatic size updates and the existing buffer flush and cursor handling.

Update the cursor-ordering test to use `draw`, preserving its assertion that the cursor moves before it is shown.

GitOrigin-RevId: 5889e9603d772945660e7ae35690d2b7326b10ae

Keep remote app-server events deliverable during shutdown (#53155)

## Why

Dropping the event receiver before shutdown lets an in-flight notification fail delivery and terminate the worker before it sends the WebSocket close frame.

## What changed

Keep the event receiver alive until `RemoteAppServerClient::shutdown` finishes waiting for the worker, allowing it to process the shutdown command and close the WebSocket.

## Testing

Extend regression tests to verify that an event remains deliverable after shutdown is queued and that the server receives `Message::Close(None)` with an extra notification in flight.

GitOrigin-RevId: ba14bc97ffa3453b7b59660144db6da9e688983d

Show subagent navigation shortcuts in TUI help (#53153)

## What changed

Add `Alt+Left` / `Alt+Right` to the shortcut overlay's Session group as “Subagents (empty prompt)”, using the existing previous/next agent binding labels.

## Testing

Update shortcut help snapshots for narrow and wide layouts, configured bindings, and running sessions to include the new entry.

GitOrigin-RevId: 534be840e1fe5646cfb9465e78049322d7e72b4c

Allow selecting and copying TUI turn tips (#53152)

## Why

Turn tips are visible outside transcript history, but their text could not be selected for copying.

## What changed

Register rendered working and completion tip rows for mouse selection. Keep tips in place when selection hints or copy status appear, and use the hint “Selecting text · esc cancel”.

## Testing

Extend mouse-selection tests and snapshots to cover selecting `/help` in working and completion tips with copy-on-select enabled, and clearing the selection when a working tip disappears.

GitOrigin-RevId: 25b3f02e7e93a53e777de455943d47fbab388ff1

Restore thread-owned permissions on cold resume (#53150)

## Why

Cold resume can replace saved unnamed permissions with current configuration defaults or recover an executor's permissions from turn context. A first-turn context can also predate an acknowledged settings update.

## What changed

- Restore eligible unnamed permission profiles from settings snapshots owned by the resumed thread, honoring explicit caller overrides and current managed requirements.
- Use owned snapshots as the authority for named permission profiles and reapply workspace permissions for the resumed workspace roots.
- Persist a thread-owned settings checkpoint after the first turn's context, serialized with settings updates so older checkpoints cannot supersede newer settings.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage for cold resume with changed defaults, managed permission restrictions, workspace-root overrides, foreign snapshots, and settings updates during first-turn processing.

GitOrigin-RevId: e411d9fd3d586a4162498c9c77c4184459071bd1

Fix startup draft recovery for pending Vim Replace keys (#53148)

## Why

Startup recovery treated a buffered Vim Replace key as an insertion, so the recovered unsent text could differ from the eventual edit. Replacing the first character of `abcd` with `X` should recover `Xbcd`, not `Xabcd`.

## What changed

Preserve the distinction between held typed keys and buffered pastes when building recovery snapshots. Apply Vim Replace semantics to held keys, including mouse selections and the bash-mode prefix offset, without consuming live pending input. Keep buffered pastes literal so the live paste path retains responsibility for large-paste and image classification.

## Testing

Add regression tests for recovery after startup draft handoff and replacement of mouse-selected text with and without the bash-mode prefix. Verify that taking a recovery snapshot leaves live input unchanged and that flushing the held key produces the same text.

GitOrigin-RevId: 97fada635ad9f0f01042b8e96020372d6df9d951

Handle broken pipes gracefully in plugin list output (#53109)

## Why

Piping `codex plugin list` into a consumer such as `head` can close stdout before the full catalog is written, causing a panic.

## What changed

Write both table and JSON output through a fallible writer and treat broken pipes during writing or flushing as success. Continue propagating other output errors.

## Testing

Add unit tests for write and flush failures in both output formats, plus CLI tests that close stdout early and verify a successful exit without a panic.

GitOrigin-RevId: cc4a64e10ad723d26b6de9e731efdc534dbee492

Add connection-bound reply handles for app-server requests (#53049)

## Why

Server request IDs can be reused across connections. Retained replies need to target the connection that emitted the request, even if the UI selection later changes.

## What changed

- Expose `AppServerReplyHandle` through `AppServerRequestHandle::server_request_reply_handle`, capturing the originating client and request ID for explicit `resolve` or `reject` calls.
- Share single-use completion state across clones so only the first reply is submitted. Dropping a handle sends nothing; stale connections return I/O errors without retrying or switching connections.
- Route existing client reply methods through request handles and use the new API in the managed worktree model test.

## Testing

Add in-process and WebSocket tests for replies on separate connections with identical request IDs, rejection routing, duplicate completion, and stale handles after worker shutdown. Also check that debug output redacts handle details.

GitOrigin-RevId: 940d0951ab67529b05919ca8ec7adb5813834b8c

Add a searchable `/config` preferences panel to the TUI (#52990)

## What changed

- Group preferences into Appearance, Notifications, Input, Sessions, and Text selection tabs, with search and links to existing theme, status line, terminal title, and keyboard editors.
- Persist preference changes to the selected local configuration file, apply supported changes immediately, and show save errors, configuration overrides, and restart requirements in the panel.
- Add a delayed notification test and controls for notification timing while preserving custom event filters.
- Add `tui.copy_on_select_clear_selection`, disabled by default, to clear transcript selection highlights only after confirmed automatic clipboard delivery.
- Keep local configuration editors usable while disconnected and prevent held activation keys or buffered input from triggering actions across editor and reconnect transitions.

## Testing

Add regression tests and rendering snapshots for panel navigation, search, dependency states, editor handoffs, offline persistence, notification timers, custom filter preservation, and confirmed-copy deselection.

GitOrigin-RevId: a16d218046060fcb6e61705a803fcd9297266e6e

Upgrade `rmcp` to `3.5.1` and harden lifecycle tests (#52972)

## What changed

- Update the pinned `rmcp` dependency and Cargo/Bazel lockfiles, and migrate MCP handlers and fixtures to `ClientConfig` and `ServerConfig`.
- Stop requiring responses for cancelled elicitation requests in cancellation tests while retaining checks for cleanup and continued connection usability.
- Handle client disconnects during WebSocket writes in the TUI test server, use an asynchronous HTTP mock for loopback proxy testing, and improve remote executor test diagnostics and the Windows subprocess fixture.
- Use `invalid_prompt` for the memory worker failure fixture.

## Testing

Add a regression test covering transport EOF during both form elicitation and user verification. Keep the client alive while checking that pending response channels close, the timeout pause clears, and the service exits with `QuitReason::Closed`.

GitOrigin-RevId: c0166b83fab3b59d84a5207c6630cb6adcf3b230

Keep startup modals protected when terminal input draining times out (#52968)

## Why

An unfinished terminal control sequence can prevent buffered input from draining before a startup modal appears. Propagating that timeout aborts modal handling instead of keeping the screen available for an explicit user decision.

## What changed

Treat input-drain timeouts as a reason to keep startup modal input quarantined. Discard key, paste, and mouse events while retrying the drain, and continue processing server events. Preserve this protection when another request resolves and when the agent overview is restored after reconnecting.

## Testing

Add a Unix PTY regression test covering unfinished control sequences, queued approval and overview shortcuts, unrelated request resolution, and overview reconnection. Verify that buffered input cannot answer an approval or create a task, while fresh shortcuts work after the drain completes.

GitOrigin-RevId: 476bedbd45f13a15d0019e4ce2e875406d4a53ca

Reuse and prewarm the WSL clipboard text reader (#52967)

## Why

WSL clipboard reads previously launched PowerShell for every paste. Process creation can hang under WSL and stall the shared clipboard worker.

## What changed

- Reuse a persistent PowerShell reader on a dedicated thread, keeping clipboard requests bounded by their deadlines and restarting the reader after errors.

Preserve per-session routing for gRPC code mode (#52381)

## Why

Sessions sharing a transport can be admitted to different hosts. Each session needs its own routing token so subsequent RPCs reach the host holding its state.

## What changed

- Capture the optional `x-code-mode-route` metadata from successful `OpenSession` responses and attach it to subsequent session RPCs. Reject tokens longer than 256 bytes and keep new admission attempts free of existing session routes.
- Invalidate a routed session when an `Unavailable` response explicitly sets `x-code-mode-route-lost: true`, allowing a later operation to reopen it without replaying the failed execution. Ordinary `Unavailable` responses preserve the session.
